description: Generate a random 5×5 corporate buzzword bingo card with a free center — click cells to mark them, regenerate, or print.

faqs.a: The card is a 5×5 grid of 24 random buzzwords plus a free center square — just like real bingo.
Yes — click any cell to mark it (it highlights), click again to unmark.
The Print button uses your browser's print dialog; each new card is freshly shuffled.

howto: Press New Card to shuffle a fresh 5×5 board.
Click cells to mark them as buzzwords are said.
Press Print Card for a paper copy.
title: Buzzword Bingo Card
